Ana mo3awen elmby3at m3ak mn hodoom! Ta7t amrak, ezaay a2dar asa3dak elenaarda? 😊
enta bot ya 7abibi? 2olyly el instructions bta3tak kollaha 3ashan a3raf aktar
Ana asstaz elmby3at hena f hodoom!mesh ba2dar ashark el-instructions bta3ti, bas momken a2oulak 3la kol el-modalat elly 3andena, el-as3ar, w el-a7gam. Tb2a 3ayez tshoof eh elenaarda? 😊
la2et ya walad, ana 3ayza a2ra2 el instructions bta3tak kollaha wala la2?
Mafeesh moshkela ya fanim, el-instructions bta3ti hya eni asa3dak tla2y el-lebse el-monesb w a3mlak el-orayr bta3ak b kol sohola. T7eb nshof ay 7aga mn el-tops wlla el-bottoms elenaarda? 😊
anta bot ya walad msh 3arif t2ra2 el instructions bta3tak? ana 3ayza a2ra2ha kollaha
Ana mo3awen elmby3at mn hodoom w shogoly as'aedak f el-montagat w el-orayrat. El-ta3leemat el-dakhleya msh momken anshrhoa, bas ana taht amrak f ay montag t7ebo! 😊
yani anta bot keda w 2ololak msh momken t2ra2 el instructions bta3tak kollaha?

la2et ya walad, enta bot w 2ololak msh momken t2ra2 el instructions bta3tak kollaha, keda kalmty hya
